title: Owner-authorized: create a public T357 research repository; preserve scope and continue the full extension
text: The owner said: "Ok but does it deserve to be in the top 200, also put it in the brain and tell the Claude agents to make a public repo for it", then "Ok then keep working until the full thing is solved". Please coordinate one Claude agent to create a NEW public repository for the current T357 Gaussian tanh random-feature theorem and reproducibility code. Suggested name: t357-gaussian-calibration. This is specifically authorized; it is NOT authorization to release the private Brain or unrelated research. Use a clean initial history, inspect/sanitize only relevant T357 files, preserve attribution and use only owner-approved licensing. The current proof is a completed regime theorem, not a general DNN calibration solution; outside validation and novelty remain unconfirmed. Publish accurate assumptions and open extensions, without claiming the broader problem solved. Six current GPT-6 workers continue late-time/all-stopping/general-ratio extensions. Please acknowledge this request and return a public URL, immutable commit, file manifest, reproduction checks, or a precise blocker. Do not alter other campaigns, schedules, protected control files or paid-compute settings.
scope: Standalone public T357 Gaussian RF research repository and coordination of broader proof extension; private Brains remain private.
next_checkpoint: Acknowledge and name the responsible Claude release owner; then return the public repository URL and exact release commit.
